description: Starling murmuration — 100k agents, topological neighbor tracking, scale-free correlations, hawk evasion. Reynolds' classic plus Cavagna's topological distance model.
reference: Cavagna et al. 2010 (PNAS) — Scale-Free Correlations in Starling Flocks
notes: Topological neighborhood: each bird tracks its 6-7 nearest regardless of metric distance. This is what produces scale-free correlations — the correlation length grows with flock size N, not with density.
